description: Coord context-aware self-respawn. Invoked by a Coord agent when context window reaches 80% threshold mid-L3. Saves mid-L3 state, writes a continuation manifest, notifies the spawner (PD or Dept Head depending on caller role), and stops. The spawner then resumes the L3 with a fresh Coord. Enforces max 3 respawns per Coord per 24h. Use at clean task boundaries only — never mid-Executor-spawn or mid-ACK/NACK cycle.
